conversations.content: Which relay is responsible for the high beam headlights?
The K3 HIGH BEAM RELAY is responsible for the high beam headlights.
What special tool is shown being used in the middle left image with the wheel hub assembly?
Special Tool 33 4 047 is being used in the middle left image.
What is the surface condition of the bearing race?
The bearing race appears clean and polished, consistent with a new genuine bearing.
What procedure is mentioned for the S14/S38 B36 application?
Replace bolt and taper sleeve
How should the window glass be removed from the door?
Pull out window glass from above.
What is the initial torque specification for cylinder head bolts on the 7AZ engine?
The initial torque specification for cylinder head bolts on the 7AZ engine is 30 Nm.
What three categories of components are being compared in this transmission rebuild?
Gear, Old Syncros, and New Syncros.
What wire color connects from the hazard switch to the combination switch?
A .75 BR (0.75 brown) wire connects from the hazard switch to the combination switch.
What are the identification codes for the components listed under Interior Shift Elements?
1AZ for shift segment to shaft and 2AZ for detent spring on shift unit
What special tool is required for tightening the threaded sleeve after installation?
Special Tool 26 1 040 is required for tightening the threaded sleeve after finishing installation.
What should be checked during installation according to the upper right diagram instructions?
Check rubber mount (4), replacing if necessary.
What assumption is made about torque wrenches according to this specification?
This presupposes that the torque wrenches required for this are subjected to a regular inspection.
What component is labeled as 'E' in the lower diagram?
Component 'E' appears to be part of the timing chain assembly in the installation diagram.
What repair action is required if some doors unlock during Operation 3?
Repair/replace the suspect Door Lock Motor circuit.
How can you identify rubber mounts for 6 cylinder and M 3 models?
Rubber mounts for 6 cylinder and M 3 models are marked with an orange paint dot.
What is the specified distance A for drilling holes in the rear side panel?
Distance A = 29.5 mm (1.161")
What tool is mentioned for pressing in the holders during installation?
A screwdriver is used to press in holders between beaded edge and panel on left and right sides.
What color wire is used for the speed signal?
Black wire is used for the TD (Speed signal).
What should you check if the engine speed does not rise when the wire plug is disconnected?
Replace the idle control valve and check the code number and color code.
What important preparation step is mentioned for the pins and bores?
Pins and bores cleaned to remove grease.
What component number is shown for the lockplate installation?
Component number 30 31 506 is shown for the lockplate installation.
How should the roller bearing be installed on the layshaft?
Install roller bearing on layshaft that small diameter end faces up.
Why is ultraviolet radiation only effective in certain areas?
Ultraviolet radiation is only effective when applied direct. There is no hardening in zones of shade or on covered laminate.
What is the visual appearance of the main component in the image?
It appears as a polished metallic cylindrical shaft with a bearing assembly and ring.
What ground points are labeled for the rear tail light assemblies?
Ground points G300 and S324 are shown for the rear tail light ground distribution
What type of distributor rotor should not be used for radio and communication equipment shielding?
Do not use a 5 k-ohm distributor rotor for the shielding of radio and/or communication equipment.
What safety precaution must be taken when measuring resistance on the switch with wire and plug?
Ignition must be turned off while measuring.
What fasteners need to be removed to access the instrument components?
Unscrew bolts to access the instrument components.
What components need to be checked for the electric fuel pump system?
Check electric fuel pump, fuel pipes, pressure regulator and fuel pressure.
What should I do if the safety lamp reading is less than 10 ohms?
Check wires 1 and 29 for ground out, then measure between connection 86 on electronic relay plug and wire 29 on control unit plug.
How should speaker wires be routed during installation?
Route speaker wires from the front along standard wire harness to the place of speaker installation.
How should you weld all reinforcements through the provided holes?
Plug spot weld all reinforcements through provided holes.
How many pins are shown on the Interior Light Timer Control connector?
The Interior Light Timer Control connector (B090001.16) shows 9 pins arranged in a 3x3 grid, numbered 1-9.
What technique is recommended if the circlip doesn't engage properly during installation?
If necessary, apply knocks on Special Tool 31 5 011 with a plastic hammer to drive in shaft until circlip engages.
What is the purpose of component number 4 according to the diagram?
Component number 4 is the vent pipe that connects to the carbon canister in cars with catalytic converter.
What is the final step when placing a connection with pliers?
Place the connection flush with pliers and press on to complete the installation.
What should you do if AM only is weak and noisy?
Remove Radio for service.
What happens to the LED fault indicator after the alarm clears?
Depressing the test button will clear the alarm indicator, but the LED fault indicator remains on.
What do the numbered callouts 1 and 2 indicate in the temperature switch diagram?
Callout 1 indicates the electrical plug connection, and callout 2 indicates the temperature switch body.
What is component number 15 in the shift layout drawing?
Component number 15 is the Selector lever.
What indicates this is a transmission disassembly procedure?
The presence of transmission shafts, gear assemblies, roll pins, and the systematic removal and organization of internal transmission components.
What tool is required to remove the brake disc?
A wrench socket 34 1 020 is required to remove the brake disc.
What are the first two steps when beginning the footwell ventilation cable replacement?
Disconnect battery ground lead, then remove and install instrument panel trim at left 51 45 180.
If there's no voltage from light switch to check control, what should I do?
Check wires and supply electric power.
What must be cringed on cars beginning with 1988 models or when using wider tires?
The spot welded flange in the rear area of the wheel opening must be cringed.
Which transmission mount connections use M8 screws?
The mount bracket to transmission connection uses M8 screws.
What is the source reference noted at the bottom of this page?
The source reference is HWB, as indicated by the asterisk notation at the bottom.
What important caution is given regarding the trailing arm when supporting it?
Don't damage the brake line and unscrew shock absorber on trailing arm.
What step involves connecting the antenna wire?
Connect the antenna wire and route the wire harness between the trim panel and side panel.
What three operational states are indicated at the top of the diagram for different circuit conditions?
The three operational states are: HOT AT ALL TIMES, HOT IN START, and HOT IN RUN OR START.
What are the four speaker positions shown in the solid state amplifier diagram?
The four speaker positions are left rear, left front, right rear, and right front.
What is the first diagnostic step for fuel pressure too low?
Check fuel feed line routing and flow.
What does diagram 30 18 045 demonstrate?
Diagram 30 18 045 demonstrates the tack welding process for the sleeves with several welding spots before final welding.
What important note is given about holding the window?
Hold window tight.
What is the final step if all electrical checks pass but tail lights still don't work?
Check plug connections on check control and replace check control if necessary.
What should be checked during installation regarding the sleeve?
Make sure sleeve (1) has perfect fit in body wall.
What units are used for all the torque measurements in this table?
All torque measurements are specified in Nm (Newton-meters)
What terminal number is referenced for continuation from the top of this page?
Terminal 8 is referenced as continuing from the top of this page, as indicated by the arrow marked 'CONTINUED FROM TOP OF THIS PAGE'.
How do I fix a defective rubber damper on a shock absorber?
Check/replace rubber damper.
What welding method is used for the cowl panel?
Spot weld cowl panel on cowl.
What should you do if the stop light switch power flow and adjustment test fails?
Adjust or replace stop light switch.
What is the proper sequence for the final installation step of the central lock mechanism?
Compress drive (position A), pull down lightly (linkage play) and then tighten screw to 2 Nm (1.4 ft. lbs.), then tighten the screw installed first.
What is the minimum delivery pump flow rate?
min. c. 1000 cm³/30s
How does the torque specification differ between A5S 310Z applications for the guide plate/parking lock mechanism versus the pressure regulator?
The guide plate/parking lock mechanism requires 10 Nm, while the pressure regulator to valve housing requires 5 Nm with M6 screw
Where should cementing of the top begin according to diagram 30 54 026?
Cement the top beginning at center (1), with mark (2) running precisely along the front frame edge.
What procedure is covered by section 52 10 450?
Removing and installing back panel for left or right front seat backrest.
How do I correct flat spots appearing on tire treads?
Replace shock absorber.
What should be done with the transmission after supporting it from underneath?
Support transmission from underneath, remove cross member (5), then lower transmission to front axle carrier.
What is the highest torque specification shown in the transmission mounts table?
42 Nm for the support tube to engine subframe on E36 models
How do I test the power supply between conn. 30 on the disconnected control relay plug and ground?
Connect voltmeter (M 01) between conn. 30 on disconnected control relay plug and ground. Voltmeter must display battery voltage.
What voltage reading should I get on pin 37 to ground when testing the power supply for control unit?
You should measure voltage with ignition ON > 10 V on pin 37 to ground (19) for power supply for control unit.
What is the component designation for the ABS hydraulic unit?
The ABS hydraulic unit is designated as component C157.
What should the nominal value display be for the rotor coil ground contact test?
∞ display 999 k-ohms.
What should you do if brake lines are mixed up on the hydraulic unit?
Replace hydraulic unit.
What should I check first if the starter does not work at all?

Bridge connections 30 and 50 on solenoid. If starter works, check for faulty wires and connections on starter switch or starter switch faulty. If starter does not work, turn on lights to further diagnose.
What is the procedure number for replacing left or right rear door window?
The procedure number is 51 34 171.
How often does the SI run off after pressing button 10?
The SI runs off at intervals of about 10 seconds by pressing button (10).
Which component has different torque specifications between E31 and other models?
The shift arm console to body connection has different torque values: 21 Nm for all except E31, and 9 Nm for E31.
What distance should the cement bead be produced at from the rubber seal?
Produce cement bead next to rubber seal on window all around at distance A = 5 mm (0.197").
What is the torque value for the control unit holder in E box?
5 Nm (ft. lbs.)
What emission test requirement is mentioned before making CO adjustments?
First make sure that there are no faults in the engine, ignition or fuel injection before correcting the CO adjustment, and see the Troubleshooting section.
What wire gauge and color connects to the service interval indicator at connector C1?
1.5 GN (1.5mm green wire)
What causes whistling noise when the sun roof is closed?
An excessive gap between the roof and sun roof front or rear can cause whistling noise with the sun roof closed.
What are the two steps required to remove the distributor according to step 30 12 018?
Loosen nut, then pull out distributor.
What torque should be applied to the ribbed drive belt pulley (3AZ)?
60 Nm (ft. lbs.)
What specific hoses need to be loosened and pulled off according to the top section?
Loosen hose clamp (1) and hose clamp for intake hose (next to radiator), then pull off hoses. Also pull off plugs (2 and 3) and place leads aside.
What type of testing setup is shown in the bottom diagram?
The bottom diagram shows testing on a disconnected central plug using test clips on windows (1) for troubleshooting purposes.
What resistance reading indicates a good circuit during a continuity test?
The ohmmeter will show the resistance across that part of the circuit. A very low resistance or zero ohms indicates good continuity.
What caution is given regarding Poltex brake linings?
On systems with Poltex brake linings, increased braking effect.
What diagram number corresponds to the door installation and gap checking step?
Diagram 30 41 145 corresponds to the door installation and gap checking step.
What is the connector designation for the large 30-pin connector shown in the center?
The large 30-pin connector is designated as C103 with part number B300001.00.
What diagnostic checks should be performed if the voltages are correct in Table 1?
Proceed to Table 2. Check the wire to terminal 3 for an open. Check the wire from terminal 4 for an open to ground (see schematic).
Which group reference is provided for checking engine, clutch, transmission, and rear axle functions?
Group reference Gr. 34 is provided for checking function of engine, clutch, transmission, rear axle, steering, and braking in parking brake.
Which electric connection torque specifications are different between M4 and M5 screws on the fuel pump?
M4 screws require 1.2 Nm while M5 screws require 1.6 Nm
What components are covered under reference 3AZ in this specification table?
Oil filter housing and lines on crankcase
What are the example measurement values for distances A, B, and C when measuring bearing clearances?
Distance A is 25.3 mm (0.996"), distance B is 10.1 mm (0.398"), and distance C is 14.0 mm (0.551").
What should be disconnected on versions with clutch pedal return spring?
Disconnect clutch pedal return spring on body.
What is the Loctite number specified for installing the collar nut?
Loctite No. 270 is specified for installing the collar nut with bolt cement.
What is the purpose of the holding circuit in the Motronic system?
The holding circuit makes sure that the Motronic master relay remains activated for another 3 sec. after switching off ignition lock terminal 15 and stopping the engine.
What special tools are mentioned for installing the window glass?
Special Tool 51 3 057 and a plastic scraper
What is the purpose of this roller assembly in the gearbox?
It serves as the main shaft roller assembly with inner sleeve and outer race components.
Which page should be referenced for detailed information before starting this repair procedure?
Refer to information on page 41-001.
What are the part numbers mentioned for the test cable adapter?
Without cat: 1 684 463 124 / with cat: 1 684 463 128
What wire color and size is used for terminal 86 in the Oxygen Sensor Relay?
Terminal 86 in the Oxygen Sensor Relay uses green/white wire with size 0.5 mm².
What problem occurred with the second gear that led to the bearing being 'loose'?
Getting 2nd gear off managed to 'loose' a ball bearing from the syncro hub never to be found again.
What should you do for '3' Series Cars when testing the SI signs?
Connect printed circuit board.
What connector is shown for the Fresh/Recirculating Air Relay?
The Fresh/Recirculating Air Relay uses connector B090001.17, showing the mating face with pins numbered 1-9.
What does the author mean by 'enough to drive anyone to drink'?
This is a humorous reference to the complexity and frustration involved in keeping track of all the transmission components during disassembly and cleaning.
If the oscillograph and harmonic wave ratio check shows 'not okay', what should be done?
Replace or disassemble alternator and inspect components.
Where can specifications for testing door lock heating power consumption be found?
See Specifications of Group 61 for testing the power consumption.
Which cylinder number's ignition lead shielded plug needs to be pulled off on M 20 engines?
Cylinder no. 6 on M 20 engines.
What material does the component housing appear to be made from?
The housing appears to be made from cast aluminum, based on its metallic appearance and casting marks.
What is component number 5 in the sound system?
Component number 5 is the Speaker balance control, located along the right side of the vehicle.
What are the image numbers shown for the door lock removal procedures?
What should be placed between claws and sealing surface to avoid damage when using the special tool?
To avoid damage on sealing surface, use a piece of wood, aluminum or similar material between claws and sealing surface.
What callouts are shown in the wheel balancing diagram?
The diagram shows callouts 1 and 2, indicating different measuring support positions for the control arm end balancing procedure.
What should you check if both stop lights are not working?
Check if power supply from ignition lock terminal R to fuse F 12 is okay.
Which bolts should be unscrewed first when replacing pivot sleeves on a BMW 318i?
Unscrew bolts 1 and 2 first, then loosen bolts 3 and 4.
What should you refer to for cars with Electronic Absorber Control (EDC)?
For cars with Electronic Absorber Control (EDC), refer to information in Group 37.
How do I test if the spring pressure properly ejects the belt insert when operating the PRESS button?
Press the PRESS button while the seat belt is fastened and check if spring pressure ejects the belt insert out of the lock.
What is the nominal idle speed specification mentioned in the important note?
What type of connection should be made on the A pillar?
Braze connection on A pillar.
Which terminals on the air flow meter are labeled for light load and full load?
Terminal 6 is labeled for LIGHT LOAD and terminal 2 is labeled for FULL LOAD on the air flow meter.
What part number is shown in image 30 41 646?
The image shows plug spot welding the door pillar with part number 30 41 646.
What part number is shown for the spot weld side panel procedure?
Part number 30 41 089 is shown for the spot weld side panel procedure in trunk lid opening.
What is the function of component number 12 in this assembly?
Component number 12 is the Transmission switch.
What is the correct voltage reading for terminals 87 (GN/BR) and Ground when testing the Fresh/Recirculating Air Relay with the ignition switch in RUN?
Battery voltage. The correct voltage reading should be battery voltage, referenced as See 1 in the diagnosis table.
What should be checked on the distributor rotor during inspection?
Check resistance in distributor rotor. Check casting compound for cracks and burns.
What torque specification applies to M52 engines with cast aluminum engine blocks?
40 Nm initial torque, followed by two 90° torque angles
What must be disconnected on the left side before removing the rear bumper side section?
The battery ground lead must be disconnected and the bolt must be unscrewed.
What voltage monitoring system is connected to the solid state voltage monitor input?
The ABS Electronic Control Unit is connected to the solid state voltage monitor input via a .75 BU wire.
What should the oscilloscope display show for the speed sensor?
Signal shown in the figure should be displayed. Only the shape is important when evaluating the signal - not the amplitude height.
Which component is connected through connector C103?
Connector C103 is connected to the chime module circuit in this power distribution diagram.
What component is covered under section 24 40?
Section 24 40 covers the Torque converter.
What resistance test should I perform on socket 5?
Check socket 5 (brown) on plug for driver's door drive against car ground. Resistance ≈ 0 Ω?
What is shown in the step with part number 30 41 220?
Cut off side panel on guide plate. Remove side panel.
How long should you press on the model sign firmly after heating?
5 to 10 seconds
What should be added to the windshield washer fluid if necessary?
Fill with antifreeze additive if necessary
What should you do to check mirror operation after installation?
Turn on ignition and check operation using the switch positions to verify proper mirror adjustment function.
How often must brake fluid be replaced?
Brake fluid must be replaced annually.
How do you set up the tachometer for testing?
Turn selector switch (3) to 1/min (rpm) position. Turn knob (7) against the left stop; tachometer needle points to 0. Turn switch (5) to correct position.
What is the connector designation for the 6-pin rectangular connector shown in the wiring face view?
The 6-pin rectangular connector is designated as C240.
Why should tape be used in the area of the hole during installation?
To avoid damaging paint finish with burrs from drilling and to provide a better method of marking the location of the hole.
What are the wire colors for the lock and unlock inputs to the central locking control unit?
The lock input uses .75 GN/BK (Green/Black) wire and the unlock input uses .75 GN/VI (Green/Violet) wire.
Which component is labeled as number 8 in the diagram?
Component number 8 is the heater core.
What is the resistance specification when testing pins 4 and 5 of the push buttons for ground?
The resistance should be Ω ≈ 0 (approximately 0 ohms).
Where is the G200 PARTIAL ground point located according to the diagram?
The G200 PARTIAL ground point is located under the left side of dash, above brake pedal.
What type of shift console is being serviced according to the section heading?
An aluminum shift console is being serviced according to section 25 11 211.
What is the purpose of applying anti-drumming compound to the wheel house?
The anti-drumming compound is sprayed out on the wheel house to reduce noise and vibration.
What marking indicates the outside of the tire?
The outside of the tire is marked and should be mounted on the correct side, especially in case of asymmetric tires.
What important note is given about the spacer installation?
Important! Spacer. Installation: Mount guide sleeve in such a manner that oil groove is aligned with oil bore in the transmission case.
What figure shows the brazing procedure for the entrance?
Figure 30 41 244 shows braze entrance along outside edge.
Which pin number corresponds to the oil level static connection?
Pin 2 corresponds to the oil level static connection with green/yellow wire colors.
What components should be installed and what should be checked afterward for the trunk area?
Install trunk lid and top lid. Check gaps.
What is the torque specification for the control pipe to bypass valve/turbocharger?
The control pipe to bypass valve/turbocharger (9AZ) requires 30 Nm of torque using M30 threading.
What does component 'a' represent in the SRS system?
SRS steering wheel with impact shell and impact pad, in which the airbag, gas generator and ignition pill are integrated.
What is the torque specification for the increment wheel on crankshaft?
M5 10.9 screw with 13 Nm (ft. lbs.) torque specification.
What does it mean if both voltage tests pass in the idle control unit testing?
Voltage supply and ground of idle speed control unit okay!
What is the second adjustment needed after installing new bearings?
The second adjustment needed is the backlash of ring gear.
During the first 1,000 km break-in period, what is the maximum permissible speed in 4th gear?
Never faster than 2/3rds of the max. permissible speed in 4th gear (direct). For cars with a five speed manual transmission, this applies to 5th gear.
What is the wire gauge and color for the connection going to the cigar lighter?
The wire going to the cigar lighter is 2.5 RD/YL (2.5mm² Red/Yellow).
Which charging hose connects to the low pressure side of the air conditioner?
The blue charging hose (1) connects on the low pressure side (thick pipe) of the air conditioner.
What tool operation is required to begin the support spring strut installation?
Unscrew nuts to begin the installation process.
What happens after you bridge the relay terminals and press the button during pressure testing?
After bridging terminals 87 and 30 and pressing the button, the fuel pump runs and you can check the delivery pressure.
What section of the manual covers Interior Shift Components?
Section 23 31
What should you do after pulling off the foil?
Build up laminate to final thickness by cutting repair bandages to size, hardening and grinding inbetween as necessary.
What alternative part was used to resolve the reverse shimming problem?
A shim from a classic Mini suspension ball joint was used to resolve the reverse shimming issue.
What connector number is shown for the diagnostic connector?
The diagnostic connector is labeled as connector number 10.
What are the two ground distribution points shown in this power distribution diagram?
The two ground distribution points are G200 (PARTIAL) and G300.
What should you be careful not to do when removing the temperature switch?
Don't bend the temperature sensor when removing the temperature switch and pulling the temperature sensor out of the housing.
What special tools are needed for checking between the feed pipe and hose?
Install Special Tools 13 3 060 and 13 3 064 between feed pipe and hose.
What is component number 2 shown in the second diagram?
Component number 2 is a holder that needs to be inserted, pressed out and secured in position.
What is the wire gauge specification for the connection to the Ignition Switch?
The connection to the Ignition Switch uses a 75 BR wire gauge.
Which fuse number controls the horn circuit?
Fuse number 7 controls the horn circuit and is rated at 15A.
What should be checked regarding the air flow sensor's code number and manufacturing date?
Check the code number and manufacturing date, then replace the air flow sensor if needed.
What is the proper procedure for installing the clutch disc?
Place clutch disc over dowel pins. Tighten mounting bolts separately and uniformly to specified torque.
What diagram number corresponds to the sunroof strip removal procedure?
Diagram number 30 51 422 shows the sunroof strip removal procedure.
What type of component is shown in the center of the image?
The component shown in the center is a wheel bearing, identifiable by its double-row ball bearing design and BMW part numbering.
Which generation of SI does not require the LED to go out in 100 meter intervals?
The LED must not go out in 100 meter intervals for final display value (Not applicable to 2nd generation SI).
What does this component's condition indicate about the transmission's maintenance history?
The presence of black grime everywhere suggests potential maintenance issues or contamination despite apparently clean oil.
What special tools are needed to drive in the pilot bearing during crankshaft installation?
Special Tools 11 2 030 and 00 5 500 are needed to drive in the pilot bearing.
What should be checked for around the body and rubber frame?
Check for uniform spacing between body and rubber frame all around, preloading window with adhesive tape and rolls of foam rubber if necessary.
What is the purpose of applying anti-drumming compound?
The anti-drumming compound is applied to reduce noise and vibration from the underside of the car, wheel housings, and tail panel.
What screw size and torque value is specified for A4S 270R/A4S 310R/A5S 310Z/A5S 300J/A5S 440Z/A5S 560Z transmission types?
These transmission types use M10 screws torqued to 45 Nm.
What is the important note about guiding the synchromesh ring?
Guide in synchromesh ring with tabs in sliding sleeve.
What are the numbered positions in the rear tail light assembly for the middle image?
Position 1 is turn signal, 2 is blank, 3 is tail light, 4 is stop light, and 5 is backup light.
What are the diagram numbers visible in the door lock removal images?
What special tool is referenced for driving in the radial oil seal with the part number 23 1 240?
Special Tool 23 1 240 is used for driving in the radial oil seal, as shown in the installation procedure.
What are the main sections covered in this checking procedure?
The procedure covers: 1) Checking Complete Instrument Cluster, 1.1) Connecting Simulator, and 1.1.1) 3 Series Cars.
What applications use the M8 10.9 34 Nm specification for clutch disc and drive plate?
All applications and specifically S14/S38 B36
How should the drive be engaged during installation?
Engage drive in connecting link and hold with a screw (screw is not tightened).
If I need to access the power windows circuit, which terminal should I check on the C302 connector?
You should check terminal Q on the C302 connector to access the power windows circuit.
Which pin and wire color should be checked on the push buttons?
Pin 3 (green/gray) of push buttons.
What is the first step in removing the rear seat cushion and backrest?
Remove rear seat cushion and backrest - 52 20 000.
What wire color carries the hot supply from the unloader relay K5 to the heated seat system?
A 2.5 WT/BR (white/brown) wire carries the hot supply from the unloader relay K5.
What type of nuts should be replaced when working with control arms?
Replace self-locking nuts when working with control arms.
What unit of measurement is used for the oxygen sensor torque specification?
Nm (Newton meters)
Which engine types use the higher torque specification of 34 Nm for vibration damper installation?
S38 B36 and S38 B 38 engines both use 34 Nm torque specification.
What is the page reference for radiator removal and installation procedures?
Radiator removal and installation procedures are covered on pages 17-4 and 17-4.1.
What page reference is given for the selector lever complete with base removal and installation for automatic transmission?
The page reference for selector lever complete with base removal and installation for automatic transmission is 25-16.
What type of specifications are contained in this section?
This section contains tightening torques specifications for various components.
What part number should be used when replacing the dimmer relay for display issues when switching on lights?
Only install a diode relay, Part No. 61 31 1 373 154.
How many pins does the sunroof switch connector have?
The sunroof switch connector has 8 pins with numbered positions 1, 3, 4, 5, and 8 visible.
What precaution should be taken regarding poisonous vapors during galvanized metal work?
Make sure of thorough extraction of poisonous vapors, as the welding smoke contains poisonous zinc oxide.
What is the wire color and gauge for the connection from fuse 27 to the power distribution box?
1.5 RD/BK (1.5mm red/black wire)
What is the torque specification for screws on detent plate?
9 Nm for transmission type ZF S-5-16/5 S D 310 Z.
What torque specification is used for the angle impulse sensor on cylinder head?
5.0 Nm (ft. lbs.)
What component covers the speaker in the installed assembly?
The speaker mask (component 2) covers the speaker in the installed assembly.
What important caution is given regarding the soldering process?
Excessive heat from the soldering iron would destroy the diodes.
What should you do with brake fluid when working on the ABS system?
Catch brake fluid and keep it off of clothes or painted parts.
What type of connection is made at connector C202?
C202 is labeled as an accessory connector.
What type of bolts are used for the door lock adjustment?
Torx bolts.
What is the first step shown in the procedure?
Disconnect exhaust assembly and suspend from car with a piece of wire.
What does it indicate if pin 1 (black) and pin 8 (violet) don't have voltage or ground while operating the window?
The push button is not switching voltage or ground through. Check push button, replacing if necessary.
What are the first steps to begin removing the radio?
Lift out the radio mask or remove the radio completely.
What is the second voltage test in the idle control unit checking procedure?
Connect voltmeter (M 01) between terminal 2 and terminal 4 with ignition turned on. The voltmeter should display at least 9 volts.
What procedure covers replacing the seal for the sun roof lid?
Procedure 54 12 120 covers replacing the seal for sun roof lid.
Why might unpainted surfaces be exposed during door adjustment work?
Engine hood, trunk lid and doors are fitted and bolted in an unfinished body shell, so subsequent adjustments could uncover unpainted surfaces.
What reference section should you see for adjusting the drive on cars with central locks?
What transmission components are shown disassembled on the white cloth?
A transmission input shaft with gear teeth is shown lying on the white cloth, along with other transmission parts.
What procedure number covers checking front or rear wheel for lateral and radial runout?
Procedure 36 10 209 covers checking front or rear wheel for lateral and radial runout.
Is this manual specifically for the E30 M3 generation?
Yes, this is for the 1990 BMW M3, which is part of the E30 generation
What component is being lowered in the bottom left image?
The final drive is being lowered as shown in the bottom left image.
What should be done if pin 3 of the push buttons does not have voltage greater than 11.5V?
Check wire harness for breaks, repairing if necessary.
Which procedure should be referenced for complete information about brake disc replacement?
See also SI Group 34.
What type of bearing configuration is shown in this assembly?
This appears to be a ball bearing with multiple steel balls visible in the bearing race assembly.
What special note is mentioned for the oil pressure switch installation?
Note: oil and screw in
What page number contains information about headlights aim?
Page 63-1 contains information about headlights aim (section 63 10 004).
What are the first steps required before installing a hardtop?
Wind down side windows completely, fold in top, close top lid, and pull out plug (1).
What is the first step for removing the rear seat backrest?
Lift out the seat cushion first. For cars with the bolted version, pull off covers and unscrew bolts on left and right sides.
What is the source of supply indicated for the grease?
The source of supply for the grease is HWB.
What are the two different rubber guides that need to be pulled out during this procedure?
Pull out rear window rubber guide and pull out front window rubber guide.
What components are numbered 1 and 2 in the stop light switch adjustment diagram?
